title: Contract criteria admit a fourth lens

criteria.statement: The release notes call out the user-visible behavior change.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The change ships with no release-note entry.

check.procedure: Read the release-note entry against the delivered change.
check.observable: An entry naming the user-visible change is present and matches the delivery.
check.conforming_case: The entry names the changed behavior a user sees.
check.falsifying_case: The notes ship without an entry for the change.
